lines.text: Good evening! A big storm is rolling in tonight, with leads arriving at 90 km/h.
Here comes a roof leak inquiry. Roofer A is up on a ladder. Roofer B has a bot.
Sorry about the leak! Can you send a photo? We have an inspection slot tomorrow at 9.
And Roofer B gets the booking! Tonight's forecast: the first to reply often gets the job.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Get storm-season ready. Comment ROOF and we'll show you how. You're still the captain.
